roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator and Infection Control Nurse
description: Join a dedicated team at a leading skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator and Infection Control Nurse. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to shape the clinical education of our staff while ensuring the highest standards of infection prevention and control are maintained. We are seeking a passionate and knowledgeable professional ready to make a significant impact on resident care and staff competency.In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, conducting new hire orientation, and providing ongoing in-service training. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, including surveillance, prevention strategies, and compliance with all regulatory guidelines. Your expertise will be crucial in fostering a safe and healthy environment for both residents and staff.This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced nurse looking to advance their career in a supportive and dynamic setting. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00. If you are committed to excellence in healthcare education and infection control, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or education within a healthcare setting
Minimum of 2 years of experience in infection prevention and control
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care and infection control
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.
